title: Structura Reditus Publishing Protocol: Canon-facing publication, source, version, and repair discipline (SR-PUBLISHING-PROTOCOL.v1.0)
source_native_claims: Self-declared status: final Tier-0 publishing protocol; adopted working standard; not a Tier-1 freeze. Finalized 2026-08-28, America/Chicago.
